name: client-guard
description: Asks you before any AWS write in a client account, enforces --region in personal projects, keeps CLAUDE.md hand-curated, and shows the AWS context above the prompt.

workRoot.title: Client work folder
workRoot.description: Sessions under this folder are client work: every AWS write asks you first. Layout assumed: <workRoot>/<Client>/<ticket-folder>.

sideRoot.title: Personal projects folder
sideRoot.description: Sessions under this folder must pass --region on every regional AWS call.

sideRegion.title: Personal default region
sideRegion.description: The region suggested when a personal-project AWS call has no --region.

ssoRegion.title: IAM Identity Center region
ssoRegion.description: Where Identity Center lives; suggested for sso-admin and identitystore calls instead of the personal default.

proposalsFile.title: CLAUDE.md proposals file
proposalsFile.description: Where blocked CLAUDE.md edits are recorded as proposals for you to review.
